name: Scavenger's Fate

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Smoothbore
perks.desc: Smooth shotgun barrel. Greatly increases range at the cost of more projectile spread.

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Barrel Shroud
perks.desc:
Balanced shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Dual Loader
perks.desc: Reloads an additional shot at a time.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 127 from 21 January 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/27QaoJnY0M7c7Ikhz8CbUv?si=397188c406294fcf) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in general, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with void builds. Scavenger's Fate's precision frame means more predictably vertical recoil - not much of an advantage for a shotgun though. At base, the stats are decent - 60 Range equates to 5.53m, 38 Stability, 37 Handling is 0.42s ready, 0.36 ADS and 0.45 stow speed, and 46 Reload speed is a 0.73s per shell reload. The magazine size is 5 at base (max 7), and with 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo count is 20/22/23/24 (max 24). First, look to boost Handling with the barrel perk. In the mag perk slot, Assault Mag increase the RPM by +5 - you can proc the origin trait to bypass reload, when needed. In the first trait column, Discord might be more thought of as a PvP perk, but the infinite ammo on kills for 7s after a kill with another weapon, plus Destabilizing Rounds in the second to spread volatility, should make for a useful way for clearing dense add crowds. The Dark Ether Reaper origin trait is one of the best in the sandbox for PvE - generate a Dark Ether charge for 5s from kills, and then shoot with any weapon (or run into) the charge to proc a Dragonfly-type detonation which also overflows equipped and stowed Dark Ether weapons to ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced, completely bypassing reload. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Scavenger's Fate fits an interesting niche. Outside of Void Synergy you also have Discord in the third column to be paired with Surrounded or Frenzy for ammo back and some hard hitting shots. The naturally tighter spread on enemies will also contribute to it feeling great. At the end of the day it's still a shotgun, ask yourself if it's worth using in PvE." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Matador 64, Retold Tale, Compass Rose, Prophet Of Doom and now Scavenger's Fate. Oh how this archetype suddenly became crowded. Lone Wolf or Slideshot coupled with Closing Time will be the roll to get, it's unique enough compared to the other offerings, so at worst give it a shot. At best it could replace that crusty Matador and give the Ogre a break." Recommended MW: Range or Handling.
